name: sealdice-js-ext-template
description: 海豹（SealDice）JS 扩展项目模板，内置 esbuild 构建、lint / 类型检查 / 冒烟测试与 sealpack 发豹包流程
license: All Rights Reserved（请自行根据开源协议调整）

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run smoke
scripts.package:check: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-sealpack.js && sealpack validate sealpack && sealpack size sealpack
scripts.pack:sealpack: node scripts/prepare-sealpack.js && sealpack pack sealpack --out dist/sealdice-js-ext.sealpack
